summary: Harden the Vercel deployment input boundary
description: Prevent manual Vercel deployments from uploading ignored local secrets, generated ACM/FCC catalogues, staged public output, dependencies, caches, or private artifacts. Add a tested .vercelignore while preserving remote build generation and the existing production function bundle.
acceptance: Vercel deployment input explicitly excludes local secrets, .vercel state, downloads, staged public output, private/generated data, dependencies, caches, logs, and database files.
Repository tests prove every required exclusion while tracked source, API, web, manifest, and build files remain available to the remote build.
A fresh manual deployment uploads only the bounded source bundle, rebuilds catalogues remotely, reaches Ready, owns the production alias, and passes live health, coverage, and MCP checks.
